title: A fresh name and a tidier phone view
changes: Ruchintachi is now RuchinDachi, with a brand-new logo.
On phones the navbar floats at the bottom of the screen, and task rows are more compact.
One-off tasks can have a due date. Pick one with the calendar button in quick add.
Edit several tasks at once with bulk edit.
Notes on a task fold away until you need them.
Hover hints now match the rest of the site.

title: Your calendar fills with gifts
changes: Each day you earned a gift shows that gift on the Calendar.
The inventory lists everything you've collected, with a count for duplicates.
Item icons are sharper.

title: Daily gifts and page backgrounds
changes: Finish every repeating task for the day and your Mii gives you a gift.
Pricier items are rarer, so keep an eye out for treasure.
Pick a page background with the round button next to the navbar. There are seven new ones to choose from.
Custom repeats, like every 3 days or the second Tuesday of each month.
Arrange today's tasks in your own order and change a task's icon right from its row.
Ticking a task off now sparkles.

title: My Chronicle opens
changes: My Chronicle has two tabs: Today for what's due now, and Tasks for everything else.
Sort your tasks into lists you make yourself.
Quick add a task, or edit one right where it is.
Sort tasks or drag them to reorder. Unfinished ones stay on top.
A countdown timer for today's tasks.
When you edit or delete a repeating task, choose "only this day" or "this day and future".
A new look, with a jelly navbar.
